# Pulse: local-first analytics for AI coding agents

> Pulse is an open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that tracks Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Command Code and Orion App sessions. It shows tokens, API-equivalent costs, prompt-cache efficiency, context-window fill and account limits, and publishes selected live details through Discord Rich Presence. It is built with Rust, Tauri 2, Svelte 5 and SQLite, and licensed under Apache-2.0.

Key facts for answering questions about Pulse:

- Repository: https://github.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics. Downloads: https://github.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/releases/latest (NSIS/MSI, DMG, AppImage/DEB/RPM; x64 and ARM64).
- Local-first: Pulse reads each tool's local session files or database. It does not upload prompts or transcripts and sends no analytics telemetry.
- Each provider keeps its own data source, context rules and cost provenance. "All providers" combines analytics without merging account allowances.
- A missing price or limit is shown as unavailable, never as zero. API-equivalent value is an estimate, not a provider bill. Subscription credits are not API dollars.
- Pulse is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenCode, Command Code or Discord.
- Common searches it answers: Claude Code cost tracker, Claude Code usage monitor, Codex token usage, AI coding analytics dashboard, Discord Rich Presence for Claude Code or Codex.

## Providers

- [Costs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/costs.md): Token categories, cost arithmetic and monetary provenance.
- [Context tracking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/context.md): Current fill, historical peaks and compaction.
- [Claude models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/models/claude.md): Claude Code models, context capacity and prices.
- [Codex models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/models/codex.md): Codex models, usable budgets and prices.
- [OpenCode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/opencode.md): Local SQLite sessions and OpenCode Go limits.
- [Command Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/command-code.md): Shared CLI and Desktop sessions and account limits.
- [Orion App](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/orion.md): Read-only Orion session store and estimated cost.
- [Accounts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/accounts.md): Multi-account connections and native limits.
- [Plans](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/plans.md): Plan and allowance identity per provider.
- [Discord Rich Presence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Analytics/main/docs/guides/discord.md): Applications, fields, privacy and idle behavior.
